Confirmed equivalent (RFC 0044, transaction-wrapping-cluster): Rails' `Migrator#ddl_transaction` calls `connection.transaction(&block)` when `use_transaction?` (migration.rb:1584-1590). trails' `ddlTransaction` delegates to `_ddlTransaction`, which on the same `_useTransaction` guard wraps the migration body in an explicit `beginTransaction()` + `commit()`/`rollback()` boundary (migration.ts:3325-3347), skipping the wrap when the adapter is already in a transaction. The atomic wrap is present via begin/commit primitives, not the `transaction` closure helper, and lives in the `_ddlTransaction` delegate rather than the Ruby-named `ddlTransaction` body — false positive, no omission.
